conclusion: Broad discovery phase is saturated. New official enforcement signals predominantly map to existing permanent IDs. Shift main effort to MIRLEX industry cards, service cards and Assistant decision trees; radar remains active at reduced speed for new law, new pattern, RED FLAG or material evidence.

cards.industry_contour: construction → excavated/repair materials and construction waste → actual destination → soil
cards.primary_source: Rosprirodnadzor, 12.05.2026: illegal placement of construction waste in Saki, Crimea; area >2.6 thousand m2; soil pollution; damage 2.85m RUB; court recovery.
cards.current_npa: Federal Law No. 89-FZ; Federal Law No. 7-FZ; current soil-damage methodology applies where damage is calculated.
cards.factual_pattern: CONSTRUCTION/REPAIR → MATERIAL/WASTE STATUS → TEMPORARY ACCUMULATION → TRANSPORT → ACTUAL DESTINATION → SOIL CONTACT → LAB → DAMAGE
cards.risk: Documents for removal do not prove lawful final destination; construction material/waste can be placed directly on soil and trigger damage recovery.
cards.evidence_court_practice: Rosprirodnadzor case published 12.05.2026; court ordered full compensation.
cards.mirlex_checks: status of material/waste; accumulation site; carrier; recipient; final destination; mass/volume reconciliation; soil contact; lab/damage gate
cards.impact: Strengthen Construction industry card and Assistant final-destination gate.
cards.red_flag: Construction waste or 'soil/material' leaves the site without a traceable lawful final destination.

cards.industry_contour: car wash → buried wastewater tank → leakage/route → soil
cards.primary_source: Rosprirodnadzor, 10.03.2026: self-service car wash GREEN; buried tank identified as pollution source; laboratory-confirmed soil contamination; >2.1m RUB recovered.
cards.current_npa: Federal Law No. 7-FZ; current soil-protection/damage rules.
cards.factual_pattern: CAR WASH → WASTEWATER → BURIED TANK → TIGHTNESS/OVERFLOW/ROUTE → SOIL → LAB → DAMAGE
cards.risk: Presence of a tank does not prove controlled wastewater management; hidden defects or untraced discharge can contaminate soil.
cards.evidence_court_practice: Rosprirodnadzor reported court recovery of >2.1m RUB.
cards.mirlex_checks: water balance; tank type/volume/tightness; pumping frequency; hauler/acceptor; volume balance; overflow/leak traces; soil sampling
cards.impact: Strengthen Car Wash card and wastewater physical-route diagnostic.
cards.red_flag: Tank/septic exists but pumping volumes and final acceptance do not reconcile with generated wastewater.
cards.update_needed: IND-CARWASH-002 + TANK_TIGHTNESS + PUMPING_LOG + ACCEPTOR + VOLUME_BALANCE + SOIL_GATE

cards.industry_contour: ROP → contract manufacturing/private label → obligated producer
cards.primary_source: Rosprirodnadzor ROP guidance, updated 11.09.2026, specifically addresses contract manufacturing and identifies the producer obligation under Art. 24.2 of Law 89-FZ.
cards.current_npa: Federal Law No. 89-FZ Art. 24.2; Government Resolution No. 2414.
cards.factual_pattern: CONTRACT → ACTUAL MANUFACTURER → GOODS/PACKAGING RELEASE → OKPD2/GIS MT → OBLIGATED ENTITY → ROP REPORTING/FEE
cards.risk: Brand owner/customer and actual manufacturer can be confused, causing ROP reporting to be assigned to the wrong entity.
cards.evidence_court_practice: Fresh official regulator guidance; no separate court case needed for this evidence item.
cards.mirlex_checks: contract terms; actual manufacturing; manufacturer identity; release records; GIS MT; codes; reporting entity
cards.impact: Keep contract-manufacturing gate mandatory in MIRLEX ROP-Учёт.
cards.red_flag: ROP responsibility is assigned only from brand ownership or invoice wording without checking actual production.

cards.primary_source: Rosprirodnadzor, 23.09.2026: requests to recyclers for data on actual recycling, produced output, customers and reuse; stated goal that recycling not be reduced to acts.
cards.current_npa: Federal Law No. 89-FZ; Government Resolution No. 742; Order of Minprirody No. 762 for recycling act form.
cards.factual_pattern: ACT → INPUT → TECHNOLOGY → OUTPUT → OUTPUT MASS → MATERIAL BALANCE → CUSTOMER/OFFTAKER → REUSE/SALE
cards.risk: Formal acts and registry status do not alone demonstrate factual recycling result.
cards.evidence_court_practice: Federal regulator-wide information request to recyclers is a systemic control signal.
cards.mirlex_checks: input mass; technology; output product; output mass; material balance; buyer/customer; transfer/reuse evidence
cards.impact: ROP-Учёт must validate factual result beyond uploaded recycling act.
cards.red_flag: Recycler can show acts and capacity but cannot show what was produced, how much, and where it went.
cards.update_needed: ROP-005 + OUTPUT_PRODUCT + OUTPUT_MASS + MATERIAL_BALANCE + OFFTAKER + REUSE_EVIDENCE

saturation_evidence.result: Predominantly additional evidence for existing IDs; no new cross-industry architecture required from this final pass.
trigger_for_new_deep_run: material court/regulator evidence that changes an existing decision tree
